verdict.rationale: CloudConvert's own job model chains tasks that run server-side without user involvement once submitted, for example importing from S3, converting, then exporting back to S3 (docs-5). Real-time status updates are available via the Socket API (docs-22). However, nothing shows first-party scheduling, triggers or standing automations; recurring hands-off workflows rely on the third-party Zapier integration (docs-10), which does not count as a CloudConvert capability. Missing for 10: native scheduled or event-triggered automations, a first-party automation builder or agent that runs unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
